title: Quietly Velvety Japanese Baby Pak Koi Okonomiyaki
description: A satvik-friendly, solo-dinner Japanese dish featuring baby pak koi, candy, and okonomiyaki, with a fatty and velvety texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the okonomiyaki flour, water, sesame oil, soy sauce, and sugar.
Add the chopped baby pak koi, crushed candy, and chopped pickled ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with a small amount of sesame oil.
Using a ladle, drop small amounts of the mixture onto the pan and shape into small circles.
Cook the okonomiyaki for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Repeat the process until all the mixture is used up.
Serve the okonomiyaki hot, garnished with additional chopped pickled ginger and crushed candy if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
